RemediationStrings.Title: Backup software is not installed
RemediationStrings.Description: Veeam Agent backup software was not found on your device, so your data is not being backed up. Please contact the helpdesk.

RemediationStrings.Title: Backup service is not running
RemediationStrings.Description: Veeam Agent is installed but its backup service is not running, so your data may not be protected. Restart your device; if this message remains, contact the helpdesk.
